subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped diagnostics.otel.protocol: grpc value now through this doctor migration, or preserve the public value until a real gRPC exporter exists?
rationale: The implementation correctly resolves the schema/runtime mismatch, but automation cannot decide whether an advertised and shipped configuration value may become invalid during upgrade and trigger operator repair.

options.title: Approve HTTP-only contract
options.body: Land the validation narrowing and doctor migration because gRPC never exported telemetry, accepting the explicit upgrade repair path.

options.title: Preserve gRPC value
options.body: Keep the existing schema contract and pause or close this PR until working gRPC export can replace the current runtime no-op behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve HTTP-only contract
recommendation.body: Land the validation narrowing and doctor migration because gRPC never exported telemetry, accepting the explicit upgrade repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the canonical config contract, doctor upgrade policy, and official diagnostics plugin behavior.
